description:
Activate Heliod targeting Triskelion, giving it lifelink until end of turn.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to deal 1 damage to any target, gaining you 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat from step 2 for infinite damage and lifegain.
